subject: Request: Short runway credits to finish POC
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@skystream.io>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-01T15:12:00Z
Subject: Short runway: trial credits to finish POC

Hi Sofia,

We're about to hit the end of our trial window for the account SKS-4492. The team has a small remaining set of tests to validate latency and the reranking behavior for an important demo next week. Usage indicates roughly ~8k tokens remaining at our current pace.

Is there a simple way to bridge us for a short runway — ideally a one-time 10k token credit or a 14-day trial extension? We don't need anything larger; just enough to wrap up the POC and share results with our CTO. If there's a self-serve option you can enable quickly that would be perfect.

Happy to provide any account info or billing contact as needed.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Sr. Machine Learning Engineer
Skystream

Ben / Marissa — forwarding a short-CR request from Skystream (SKS-4492). Customer is asking for a lightweight bridge (approx 10k tokens or ~2 weeks) to finish a POC demo next week. They specifically asked for a self-serve toggle if possible.

Policy-wise I think this is eligible for a one-time courtesy credit (PLG small account, non-enterprise). Ben, can you authorize a 10k token issuance via the console self-serve credits flow? Neha, please update the HubSpot deal and mark as "courtesy trial bridge" if Ben signs off.

Quick notes:
- Customer usage looks within typical PLG trial patterns (no suspicious spikes).
- No procurement contract on file; this is pre-sales.

Thanks — I can reply to Samir once we have confirmation.

—Sofia

I authorize a one-time 10,000 token trial credit to SKS-4492 and will enable the self-serve credit grant in the console now. Neha — please log the issuance under deal SKS-4492 and tag it "trial_bridge_courtesy". Marissa — flag for follow-up next week to see if they convert after the demo.

Hi Samir — good news. Per our internal approval, we've issued a one-time 10,000 token credit to your trial account (SKS-4492). You should see the balance reflected in the Console under Usage -> Credits within a few minutes.

How to redeem: log in to the Console, open the account dropdown, and select "Apply trial credit" — the credit is already assigned to the account so no promo code is necessary. The credit will be consumed against generation tokens and is valid for 30 days from issuance.

If anything looks off after you run the next tests, reply here and we'll take a look immediately. Would love a quick note on how the POC goes — we can schedule a short sync with Ben the week after your demo.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
